items.label: Dual Cat Paradise
items.value: This cat litter box enclosure adopts a dual-space design, ideal for pet-loving households. Two cats can indulge in their private moments, unbothered and harmonious, whether it's for toilet breaks or naps, enhancing their comfort

items.label: Versatile Furniture
items.value: This vertically designed cat litter box house combines storage, resting and entertainment with space maximization. It blends practicality with aesthetics, making it a haven for feline life and an invaluable asset for pet owners

items.label: Interactive Fun with Toys
items.value: With 2 hanging balls and a toy ball, this wooden litter box enclosure caters to cats' hunting instincts. It encourages exercise and boosts vitality, allowing your feline friend to unleash its energy and savor joyful moments

items.label: Seamless Home Integration
items.value: Boasting a simple yet cozy appearance, this cat furniture fits well into any home decor. It stands as both a private area for your cat and a stylish accent, reflecting your meticulous care and unique taste for pet living

items.label: Easy Cleaning
items.value: This hidden litter box enclosure has a fenced top for pet treats, toys, etc. and a corrugated paper litter filter at the entry tunnel for cat's scratching and litter spilling prevention. Its elevated bottom simplifies daily cleaning
